description: Temporarily neutralize Frame Conn's Foundry-wide Elevation / LOS feature so another module can own elevation without conflict, while preserving the implementation and leaving explicit restoration instructions in code.

scope_lock.original_user_instruction: Go to the Lancer Framecon repo, locate the elevation code, and don't delete it; comment it out and snip its dependencies with comments saying what was done and how to restore it exactly. Use the repo's Dev Scripts toolchain and workflow.
authorized_deliverables: Temporarily disconnect the existing Foundry-wide Elevation / LOS feature from canonical feature registration.
Remove the runtime orchestrator's hard dependency, startup calls, and public API exposure for that feature while it is suspended.
Leave explicit in-code comments that identify the suspension and tell a future maintainer exactly what to uncomment to restore the current behavior.
Validate the narrow change through the canonical GitHub FilePatcher mutation, simulation, audit, rollback, diff-validation, and bot-commit path.
forbidden_expansions: Do not delete or modify any file under scripts/foundry_features/elevation_los/.
Do not change elevation/LOS algorithms, flags, wrappers, hooks, config UI, or document commands themselves.
Do not change movement rules or generic token elevation handling outside the Foundry-wide elevation/LOS feature.
Do not change unrelated Frame Conn features, gameplay rules, UI, or developer tooling.
Do not replace the suspended implementation with a new elevation implementation.

acceptance_criteria: Frame Conn no longer imports or registers frameConnElevationLosFeature at runtime.
runtime-orchestrator.js no longer requires the elevation-los API to exist.
runtime-orchestrator.js no longer calls the elevation-los initialize or ready API while suspended.
game.lancerFrameConn no longer exposes the Frame Conn elevationLOS API while suspended.
All files under scripts/foundry_features/elevation_los/ remain unchanged.
The disabled registration and runtime wiring remain visible as comments next to restoration instructions, so restoration consists only of uncommenting the preserved lines/blocks.
Frame Conn startup dependency validation continues to succeed without the elevation-los feature registered.
Canonical GitHub FilePatcher dry-run/apply validation and repository diagnostics pass.
non_goals: Change Lancer movement mechanics that merely read token elevation.
raw_operations_reason: The preferred authoring-intent route was attempted first and failed before mutation only because the clause-aware Patch Corridor could not classify the already-inspected registration, initialize, ready, and restoration-comment seams. The exact two-file runtime wiring was directly verified, so six deterministic exact replacements are being sent through the documented raw-operations escape hatch while retaining GitHub FilePatcher as mutation authority and retaining its normal dry-run, simulation, audits, rollback, diff validation, and bot commit.
